@@U01161@@
浮士德 walking up and down in meditation.
梅菲斯特 joins him.

@@U01163@@
By love scorned!
By the fires of Hell! Ah,
if only I knew something worse to curse by!

@@U01165@@
What is it? What's eating you?
I’ve never seen such a face!

@@U01167@@
If I weren't the Devil myself,
I'd say “Devil take me!”

@@U01169@@
Have you lost your mind?
On second thought, it suits you!
A raving lunatic!

@@U01171@@
Imagine!
Those jewels I got for 格蕾琴?
Some priest’s just come along and snapped them up!
No sooner her mother’s eye spies them,
she goes all jittery with some secret horror.
Some nose that woman's got!
Always sniffing her prayer book.
One whiff
and she knows if something’s holy or unholy.
She knew on the spot
there wasn't much blessing in those jewels.
“Child,” cries she, “ill-gotten goods
ensnares the soul and corrupts the flesh.
We'll offer these up to God’s own Mother,
and she'll shower down manna from Heaven on us.”
translation:
@@U01161@@
浮士德在冥想中走来走去。
梅菲斯特加入了他。

@@U01163@@
被爱所蔑视！
借着地狱之火！啊，
要是我知道更糟糕的咒骂就好了！

@@U01165@@
它是什么？你在吃什么？
我从来没有见过这样的脸！

@@U01167@@
如果我自己不是恶魔的话
我会说“魔鬼带走我！”

@@U01169@@
你失去理智了吗？
转念一想，它很适合你！
一个胡言乱语的疯子！

@@U01171@@
想象一下！
我给格蕾琴买的那些珠宝？
一些牧师刚刚过来就把它们抢走了！
她母亲的眼睛一看到他们，
她因某种隐秘的恐惧而变得紧张不安。
这女人的鼻子真好！
总是嗅着她的祈祷书。
一闻
她知道某件事是神圣的还是邪恶的。
她当场就知道了
那些珠宝并没有多少祝福。
“孩子，”她喊道，“不义之财
诱惑灵魂，腐蚀肉体。
我们将把这些献给上帝的母亲，
她会从天堂向我们倾洒甘露。”
